name: Zatanna
summary: A stage magician whose tricks are absolutely real. Zatanna Zatara casts spells by saying words backwards and ranks among the Justice League's top experts in the occult.
origin: Zatanna is a stage magician whose tricks are real, and she has more fun with magic than anyone else in DC. Gardner Fox and Murphy Anderson introduced her in Hawkman #4 in 1964, and her early adventures had her popping up in different heroes' books as she searched for her missing father, the Golden Age magician Zatara. She casts spells by speaking words backwards, which sounds silly until she rearranges reality with a sentence. Between gigs as a top-hatted showgirl and escape artist, she is one of DC's best occult experts and a longtime Justice League member, with a complicated history with Batman, who trained under her father.
powers: Expert in demons and the occult
Master stage magician and escape artist

storyline.title: Searching for Dad
storyline.beat: Stage magician Zatanna debuts in Hawkman #4, searching for her missing father, the magician Zatara. The search runs through several DC titles until 1967.

storyline.title: Joining the League
storyline.beat: Zatanna becomes a full member of the Justice League of America.

storyline.title: Mind wipes
storyline.beat: Identity Crisis reveals she once erased memories, including from a villain and from Batman, which damages her friendships.

storyline.title: San Francisco stage
storyline.beat: Paul Dini writes a solo series about Zatanna balancing her stage show with real magic threats.

storyline.title: Leading the weird
storyline.beat: Zatanna anchors the Justice League Dark, a team that handles magical threats.

gossip.text: She casts spells by saying words backwards.
Her father Zatara debuted in Action Comics #1 in 1938, the same issue as Superman.
Bruce Wayne trained with her father as a young man, and she and Bruce have known each other for years.
Paul Dini, her biggest champion as a writer, is married to a real-life magician, Misty Lee.

quiz.q: How does Zatanna cast her spells?
Which magic team did Zatanna anchor in 2011?

theme.tagline: Says it backwards, makes it happen forwards.

timeline.title: The magician's daughter
timeline.note: Hawkman #4 introduces Zatanna, a stage magician who casts real spells by speaking backwards.

timeline.title: The quest ends
timeline.note: Her hunt for missing dad Zatara, spread across several titles, wraps up in Justice League of America #51.

timeline.title: Joining the League
timeline.note: Zatanna is voted into the Justice League in Justice League of America #161.

timeline.title: Identity Crisis
timeline.note: A bombshell: she wiped villains' minds, and even Batman's memory, at the League's request.

timeline.title: Smallville spellcaster
timeline.note: Serinda Swan plays Zatanna on Smallville, the first live-action version of the character.

timeline.title: Her own series
timeline.note: Paul Dini writes a Zatanna ongoing series full of stage-magic glamour and San Francisco mystery.

timeline.title: Justice League Dark
timeline.note: The New 52 makes her a core member of Justice League Dark, DC's team for supernatural threats.
